caption: MCP Jsonrpc Response
description: A response to a request, containing either the result or error. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 JSONRPCResponse; 2026-07-28 JSONRPCResponse).
name: mcp_jsonrpc_response

mcp_jsonrpc_result_response.description: The value when it is the alternative JSONRPCResultResponse.

mcp_jsonrpc_error_response.description: The value when it is the alternative JSONRPCErrorResponse.

mcp_unresolved.description: The value exactly as reported when no single alternative matches it by its constant and required members.
